entry.title: Basel Committee finalises consolidated guidelines and sound practices and consults on technical amendments
entry.summary: 国際関係,バーゼル銀行監督委員会による「統合されたガイドライン及びサウンド・プラクティス」の最終化及び市中協議文書「技術的改訂―統合されたガイドライン及びサウンド・プラクティス」について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 12, 2026 · GuidanceThe Basel Committee finalised its consolidated guidelines and sound practices and published a consultative document on technical amendments. The consolidation reorganises existing guidelines into a new format to improve accessibility and does not propose content changes. The consultation proposes updating cross-references in the Basel Framework and moving some Application guidance into the consolidated guidelines. Comments are due in English by 21 December.

entry.title: Update to Warning Page on Unauthorized Access and Trading in Online Brokerage Services
entry.summary: 「インターネット取引サービスへの不正アクセス・不正取引にご注意ください」のページを更新しました。 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency updated its warning page on unauthorized access and unauthorized trading in online brokerage services. Customer login credentials stolen through phishing sites imitating real securities firms were used by third parties to sell holdings and buy small-cap stocks. An attached table lists monthly case counts and amounts (provisional) from January 2025 to September 2026.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (October 30, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年10月30日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 10, 2026 · SpeechAt a press conference after the cabinet meeting, Japan's Finance Minister Katayama addressed the deliberation of the consumption tax support payment bill and the shift of the tax-exempt shopping system for foreign tourists to a refund-based method. He also responded to questions on phasing down gasoline subsidies, electricity and gas bill support, and transfers of surplus from the foreign exchange special account.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (Nov 2, 2026): tax revenue estimates, US-Japan joint statement, and yen policy
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣繰上げ閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月2日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 10, 2026 · SpeechAt a post-cabinet press conference on November 2, 2026, Finance Minister Katayama responded to Prime Minister Takaichi's instruction to improve the accuracy and transparency of tax revenue estimates for the FY2027 budget. He also said Japan would act in line with the US-Japan joint statement against disorderly or excessively speculative currency moves ahead of the US midterm elections, and outlined his position on yen exchange rates.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (November 6, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月６日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 11, 2026 · SpeechFinance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference covered a 10 billion yen reserve fund allocation for strengthening cybersecurity measures. He also answered questions on the consumption tax and support payment bill under Diet deliberation and on Russia's temporary placement of JTI's Russian subsidiary assets under Russian company management. The government has protested to Russia and requested withdrawal of the measure.

entry.title: Summary of Minister Katayama's Post-Cabinet Press Conference (November 10, Reiwa 8)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月10日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 11, 2026 · SpeechAt a post-cabinet press conference on November 10, 2026, Finance Minister Katayama addressed the use of Bank of Japan ETF sale proceeds as a funding source, the parliamentary deliberation on the consumption tax and support levy bill, and the product redesign and tax treatment of individual government bonds. He stated that monetary policy tools are for the BOJ to decide and that government expectations of BOJ remittances will not affect its operations.

entry.title: FSA Publishes Minutes of First 2026 Meeting of Study Group on Digital and Decentralized Finance
entry.summary: 「デジタル・分散型金融への対応のあり方等に関する研究会」（令和８事務年度第１回）議事要旨について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 11, 2026 · Report · CryptoTopic evidence: 「「デジタル・分散型金融への対応のあり方等に関する研究会」（令和８事務年度第１回）議事要旨」 The Financial Services Agency published the minutes of the first meeting for fiscal 2026 of its study group on how to respond to digital and decentralized finance. The meeting was held on October 20, 2026, and heard presentations from Nomura Holdings and Securitize Japan. Discussion covered on-chain finance, stablecoins and tokenized deposits, security tokens, DEX and DeFi, and the book-entry transfer system.

entry.title: Notice of the 7th meeting of the Financial System Council's Disclosure Working Group
entry.summary: 金融審議会「ディスクロージャーワーキング・グループ」（第７回）の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 11, 2026 · MeetingThe Financial Services Agency announced the 7th meeting of the Financial System Council's Disclosure Working Group, to be held on November 18, 2026, from 15:30 to 18:00 at the Central Government Building No. 7. The agenda covers hearings and discussion, with no public gallery seats and a live stream on YouTube.

entry.title: Warning: Transactions with Unregistered Operators Carry High Risk
entry.summary: 「無登録業者との取引は要注意！！～ 無登録業者との取引は高リスク ～」のページを更新しました。 金融庁 · Nov 10, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「日本の居住者を相手に、株取引やＦＸ取引、暗号資産取引などの金融商品取引業・暗号資産交換業を行う者は、日本の法令に基づき、登録を受ける必要があります。」 The Financial Services Agency of Japan warns that operators conducting financial instruments or crypto-asset exchange business with residents of Japan must be registered. Unregistered operators cannot be verified by authorities for investor-protection arrangements, and many complaints cite withdrawal refusals, excessive fees, and sudden loss of contact. The notice provides a list of registered operators, ways to check for warnings, and consultation and information contacts. The archived text and attachments run to about 236,607 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original.

entry.title: FSA Recruitment of a Lawyer for Insurance Monitoring Work
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（保険会社等のモニタリング業務等に従事する職員【弁護士】） 金融庁 · Nov 10, 2026 · PersonnelThe Japanese Financial Services Agency is recruiting one lawyer for monitoring insurance companies, including compliance checks, legal review for supervisory work, and revisions to supervisory guidelines. The post is a fixed-term regular national civil servant position based in Tokyo, for about two years from around January 2027.

entry.title: FSA announces public symposium on climate risk industry-government-academia network
entry.summary: 気候変動リスク産官学連携ネットワーク公開シンポジウム～気候関連開示からレジリエンス強化への実践～の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 9, 2026 · MeetingThe FSA, together with the Ministry of the Environment, MEXT, MLIT and NIES, will hold an online public symposium on November 27, 2026. Titled "From Climate-Related Disclosure to Practice in Strengthening Resilience," it includes a keynote, corporate case presentations, updates from host ministries and a panel on physical climate risk. Capacity is 1,000 on a first-come basis, and attendance is free.

entry.title: Announcement of the 7th meeting of the Japan-EU Joint Financial Regulatory Forum.
entry.summary: 国際関係,「日ＥＵ合同金融規制フォーラム」第７回会合の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 6, 2026 · MeetingThe FSA and the European Commission held the seventh Japan-EU Joint Financial Regulatory Forum meeting in Tokyo on 4 and 5 November 2026. Participants exchanged views on market developments, financial stability risks, sustainable finance, digital finance, AI, cybersecurity, banking, insurance and capital markets. They reaffirmed the importance of international standards and multilateral cooperation. entry.title: FSA recruits a part-time specialist investigator for monitoring system work
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（モニタリング高度化に係るシステムに関する業務に従事する専門調査員（非常勤職員）） 金融庁 · Nov 6, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency is recruiting one part-time specialist investigator. The role covers maintenance of the FIMOS financial monitoring system and planning analytical features to advance monitoring. The employment period runs from January to the end of March 2027, and applications close on November 20, 2026.

entry.title: FSA Urges Financial Users to Stay Alert Against Cyber Threats
entry.summary: 現下の情勢を踏まえた金融機関利用者へのお願いについて公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 6, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency of Japan issued a notice asking financial institution customers to take precautions after recent unauthorized access incidents led to leaks of customer data. It advises not clicking links in suspicious emails, avoiding password reuse, using phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication, and promptly contacting the financial institution about unrecognized transaction notices. An attached National Police Agency letter also outlines basic security measures for individuals and organizations.

entry.title: Agenda for the 3rd meeting of the Financial System Council's working group on capital supply to growth companies
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第３回）の議事次第について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 6, 2026 · MeetingThe Financial Services Agency published the agenda for the third meeting of the Financial System Council's working group on capital supply to growth companies. The meeting was held on November 9, 2026, with hearings from the Japanese Bankers Association, the Japan Financial Services Association and a lawyer, plus Secretariat briefings and discussion. Materials cover commitment lines for funds, supervisory rules for money lenders and digitization of written delivery requirements. entry.title: FSA publishes survey results on financial institutions' measures for persons with disabilities (as of end-March 2026)
entry.summary: 障がい者等に配慮した取組みに関するアンケート調査の結果（令和８年３月末時点）について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 6, 2026 · ReportThe Financial Services Agency surveyed financial institutions on their efforts to accommodate persons with disabilities as of the end of March 2026 and published the results. The survey covers the installation rate of ATMs usable by visually impaired people, internal rules on reading and writing assistance, and responses to contact via telephone relay services and Yomitel.

entry.title: FSA publishes results of public comments on proposed amendments to comprehensive supervisory guidelines for major banks and others
entry.summary: 「主要行等向けの総合的な監督指針」等の一部改正（案）に対するパブリックコメントの結果等について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 6, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency published the results of its public comment period on proposed amendments to the comprehensive supervisory guidelines for major banks and other institutions, which ran from July 30 to August 31, 2026, receiving 21 comments from nine individuals and organizations. The amendments clarify measures needed to prevent user misunderstanding when banks provide services with other businesses via APIs, and whether a third party's conduct constitutes bank agency (intermediary) business. The revised guidelines apply from November 6, 2026.= The archived text and attachments run to about 51,309 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original.

entry.title: FSA and CDSC announce data link for Climate Data Utility covering Japanese firms
entry.summary: 国際関係,金融庁及びClimate Data Steering CommitteeによるClimate Data Utilityに関するデータ連携の開始について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 30, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency and the Climate Data Steering Committee announced a partnership integrating climate-related data from over 800 Japanese companies disclosed via EDINET into the Climate Data Utility, a global open data platform. The data covers greenhouse gas emissions and climate targets, expanding the platform to nearly 22,000 companies. The link does not impose new disclosure obligations on Japanese firms.
